facts.text: Maximum safe collision-mitigation braking applies when a collision is otherwise unavoidable within the conservative stopping envelope and uses maximum braking consistent with the current stability and control constraint.
facts.quote: collision otherwise unavoidable within the conservative stopping envelope; maximum braking consistent with the current stability and control constraint

facts.text: Maximum safe collision-mitigation braking risks rollover, articulation instability, payload shift and sliding.
facts.quote: risks rollover, articulation instability, payload shift and sliding.

facts.text: No universal off-road deceleration value for maximum safe collision-mitigation braking was found.
facts.quote: No off-road universal deceleration value was found.

facts.text: Stopped-state hold maintains the brake or hold when the machine is at zero speed while the hazard remains.
facts.quote: machine at zero speed while the hazard remains; maintain brake or hold

facts.text: Stopped-state hold prevents a machine from creeping into an obstacle.
Releasing stopped-state hold can cause machine rollback or roll-forward.
facts.quote: release can cause rollback or roll-forward.

facts.text: Motion inhibit from standstill rejects or limits the propel or articulation command when an object is already in the projected path before launch.
facts.quote: object already in the projected path before launch; reject or limit the propel or articulation command

facts.text: Motion inhibit from standstill addresses a hazard that time to collision cannot represent: an object already in the projected path before launch.
facts.quote: solves the hazard that time to collision cannot represent

facts.text: Nuisance motion inhibits from standstill disrupt close-proximity tasks.
Motion inhibit from standstill has been fielded underground on continuous miners.
Selective function disable uses position-dependent zone logic to disable only hazardous motions, as in NIOSH intelligent proximity detection.
facts.quote: position-dependent zone logic that disables only hazardous motions (NIOSH intelligent proximity detection)

facts.text: Selective function disable adds complexity and depends on zone accuracy.
facts.quote: adds complexity and depends on zone accuracy.

facts.text: The transition between partial and full intervention should be calibrated using remaining stopping margin and its uncertainty, not range alone.
facts.quote: The transition between partial and full intervention should not be calibrated by range alone. It should depend on the remaining stopping margin and its uncertainty

facts.text: At identical nominal distance, intervention calibration should distinguish a well-localized rigid wall on dry hard-packed ground from a partially occluded person near a machine on downhill mud.
facts.quote: a well-localized rigid wall on dry hard-packed ground is different from a partially occluded person near a machine on downhill mud, even at identical nominal distance.
